name: gta6-mcp
description: Grand Theft Auto VI companion for Claude: live GTA Wiki lookups, official facts, console-aware and spoiler-aware answers.
long_description: Ask Claude anything about Grand Theft Auto VI. This extension gives Claude live access to the community GTA Wiki (missions, vehicles, characters, weapons, locations, radio…) plus a small set of sourced official facts (release, platforms, PC status, setting). Answers use your console's button names (PlayStation or Xbox) and story-heavy pages are withheld unless you agree to spoilers. GTA VI is console-only, so there are no save files to read; tell Claude where you are in the story for tailored help.

console.title: Your console (optional)
console.description: ps5, ps5-pro, xbox-series-x or xbox-series-s — answers will use your controller's button names.

tools.name: gta6_overview
tools.description: Official facts plus the live wiki summary.

tools.name: gta6_platform
tools.description: Platform status, PC release status and controller vocabulary.

tools.name: gta6_search
tools.description: Search the GTA Wiki (GTA VI first).

tools.name: gta6_page
tools.description: Read a wiki page or section, spoiler-aware.

tools.name: gta6_list
tools.description: List missions, vehicles, characters, weapons, locations and more.

prompts.name: spoiler_free_help
prompts.description: Ask for help without story spoilers.
prompts.text: I'm playing GTA VI (progress: ${arguments.progress}). ${arguments.question} Use the gta6 tools, cite the wiki, and don't spoil anything beyond my progress.
